source.source_name: LiveBench dated official leaderboard CSV
source.notes: LiveBench 2.0. Overall is the arithmetic mean of the suite scores available for a model, so every suite counts equally; no rank is inferred. Release discovery reads the official site app bundle; paired CSV and taxonomy JSON are fetched from data/<release>/ with no stale fallback.

source.source_name: LiveBench Coding dated official leaderboard CSV
source.notes: Official LiveBench 2.0 suite Coding; bug-fix tasks from real merged pull requests. Scores are averaged only within this suite.

source.source_name: LiveBench Browser dated official leaderboard CSV
source.notes: Official LiveBench 2.0 suite Browser; multi-step tasks completed through a real browser. Added by 2.0, replacing the v1 Language suite.

source.source_name: LiveBench Long-Horizon dated official leaderboard CSV
source.notes: Official LiveBench 2.0 suite Long-Horizon, introduced by 2.0; the v1 Mathematics suite no longer exists in this taxonomy.

source.source_name: LiveBench Data Analysis dated official leaderboard CSV
source.notes: Official LiveBench 2.0 suite Data Analysis; short table questions with a single correct answer.

source.source_name: LiveBench Reasoning dated official leaderboard CSV
source.notes: Official LiveBench 2.0 suite Reasoning; short logic, spatial and theory-of-mind questions.

source.source_name: LiveBench Design dated official leaderboard CSV
source.notes: Official LiveBench 2.0 suite Design, whose single subtask column is design_layout. Added by 2.0, replacing the v1 Agentic Coding suite.

source.source_name: LiveBench Research dated official leaderboard CSV
source.notes: Official LiveBench 2.0 suite Research; open-ended research briefs graded against a rubric. Added by 2.0, replacing the v1 IF suite.
